name: AGX
recent: AGX 近期有多项董事与主要股东持股变动公告，包括非执行董事 Penu Mark 及执行董事 Dato' Ponnudorai 在公开市场增持股份。公司也发布了截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度的业绩报告。新闻方面，公司正推动航空物流业务，作为转型增长方向。
notable: 非执行董事 Penu Mark 在公开市场增持公司股份。
执行董事 Dato' Ponnudorai A/L Periasamy 在公开市场增持公司股份。
公司发布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度的业绩报告。
risks: 董事在闭窗期前申报有意交易股份，随后在闭窗期内进行交易。

recent_en: AGX recently saw several announcements on changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests, including on-market acquisitions by Non-Executive Director Penu Mark and Executive Director Dato' Ponnudorai. The company also released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026. In the news, the company is pushing into aerospace logistics as a transformative growth direction.
notable_en: Non-Executive Director Penu Mark acquired shares in the company on the open market.
Executive Director Dato' Ponnudorai A/L Periasamy acquired shares in the company on the open market.
The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026.
risks_en: A director declared intention to deal during the closed period and subsequently traded within the closed period.
